messages:
Carmen (Partnerships): Quick sync request 4dd LangChain wants a compact pilot: orchestrator flows -> Redwood gateway -> EdgePilot HW. Need owners for adapter QA, marketplace tile, SI playbook, and embargo timing. Volunteers?
Eli (Eng-Platform): I can take adapter QA and the staging helm. Will need the connector contract and a tiny runner image (orshim).
Samira (LangChain PM): Uploading a minimal runner + connector doc today: https://drive.example/lc/edgepilot. Note: supports streaming + tool-calls; default auth = api_key.
Noor (Product): I'll draft marketplace tile + a private-pilot SKU. Proposal: "invite-only" listing for first 30 days.
Kai (Eng-ML): For HW validation Ill run three perf sweeps (tiny/med/large) and tokenization parity. EdgePilot runs INT8; will need quantized images.
Eli (Eng-Platform): Flag: keep autoscale off on sandbox cluster so perf runs are stable. Also requesting a compatibility matrix: endpoints, streaming chunking, tools, kv-cache.
Samira (LangChain PM): Compat snippet you can use:
```
POST /v1/complete -> streaming:true, chunk_size:128
POST /v1/tools -> supports_tools:true
compat_tag: "lc-0.36"
```
Carmen (Partnerships): Owners recap: Eli (adapter QA), Noor (marketplace & SKU), Kai (HW perf), Samira (assets). I'll block legal review (T+5) and marketing blurb (T+10).
benji-bot: Preview deploy scheduled: lc-edgepilot-sandbox -> staging at 2025-11-03T13:00Z (deploy id: dep_1182).
Eli (Eng-Platform): After deploy I'll run smoke matrix and post results to repo: https://git.internal/redwood/partners/lc-edgepilot. Ping here when assets live.
Noor (Product): Marketplace WIP:
```
name: "Redwood x LangChain: EdgePilot Sandbox"
sku: RW-LC-EDGE-SBX-001
availability: "Invite-only pilot"
```
Will add SI add-on SKU for reserved trials.
Kai (Eng-ML): I'll upload gbench configs and expected p50/p95 bounds. Also including tokenization diff tool.
Carmen (Partnerships): Timeline draft:
- Today: assets in (Samira)
- +2 days: staging deploy + smoke (Eli)
- +5 days: legal & dep scan (legal)
- +10 days: invite webinar + SI onboarding
I'll send calendar invites and a short checklist. Thanks all :rocket:
